заголовок: Where to use Google’s image generator Nano Banana Pro now
дата_в_тексте: Dec 23, 2025 (в тексте; meta article:published_time 2025-12-23T17:00:00+00:00; JSON-LD dateModified 2025-12-29T16:40:29)

официальность.второй_признак: JSON-LD publisher «Google» (Organization); текст от лица Google («our latest image generation and editing model», «Flow, our AI filmmaking tool», «Antigravity — our new agentic development»); автор Molly McHugh-Johnson с подписью «Contributor» блога Google.

картина: Пост блога Google (23.12.2025) для пользователей и отчасти разработчиков: где доступен Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image). По поверхностям: Gemini app (выбрать «Create images» + модель «Thinking»; у free-tier лимиты, затем откат на оригинальный Nano Banana; у AI Plus/Pro/Ultra квоты выше), AI Mode в Search («Thinking with 3 Pro» → «Create Images Pro»; отдельные страны, английский), NotebookLM (Slide Decks, Infographics), Workspace (Slides: «Help me visualize», «Beautify this slide»; Vids: кнопка Image с бананом), Flow (контроль кадра, ракурс/фокус/цветокор, рендер текста; только платные планы), Mixboard (презентации), для разработчиков Vertex AI/AI Studio/Stitch/Firebase/Antigravity и Google Ads. Промпт-советов почти нет. Повторный акцент: точность и контроль.
модели_на_странице: Gemini 3 Pro (текстовая основа Nano Banana Pro)
структура: для разработчиков и Google Ads (без заголовка)

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro is Google's image generation and editing model; it uses Gemini 3 Pro to better understand what you want to visualize and to generate it with higher precision, more depth and nuance, and incredible detail.
единицы.цитата: to better understand what you want to visualize and generate it with higher precision, more depth and nuance and incredible detail.
единицы.заметка: Предыдущая строка txt: «We recently launched Nano Banana Pro, our latest image generation and editing model. Nano Banana Pro uses» + «Gemini 3 Pro» (ссылка). Механизм: понимание намерения идёт через Gemini 3 Pro.

единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro is available globally in the
единицы.заметка: Строка обрывается ссылкой «Gemini app», далее «on desktop or via the mobile app.»

единицы.утверждение_en: To use Nano Banana Pro in the Gemini app, select "Create images" and choose the "Thinking" model.
единицы.цитата: You can simply select “Create images” and choose the “Thinking” model to use it.

единицы.утверждение_en: Free-tier Gemini app users have Nano Banana Pro limits; after reaching them the app goes back to using the original Nano Banana.
единицы.цитата: There are limits for free-tier users, and the app will go back to using the original Nano Banana after you reach them
единицы.заметка: «original Nano Banana» = gemini-2.5-flash-image (раскрыто по словарю моделей задания). Числа лимитов на странице нет — только ссылка «higher quotas».

единицы.заметка: Продолжение фразы — ссылка «higher quotas» (support.google.com/gemini/answer/16275805) на отдельной строке txt.

единицы.утверждение_en: To use Nano Banana Pro in AI Mode in Search: while signed in, open AI Mode, select "Thinking with 3 Pro" from the dropdown, click the plus sign icon, choose "Create Images Pro", then describe your image.
единицы.цитата: select “Thinking with 3 Pro” from the dropdown menu, click the plus sign icon and choose “Create Images Pro.” Describe your image and Nano Banana Pro will take it from there!
единицы.заметка: Условие «While signed into your account» — в строке 258 перед этим.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro is available to all NotebookLM users globally, powering Slide Decks and Infographics that turn sources and ideas into visual narratives.
единицы.цитата: users globally, so you can turn sources and ideas into visually compelling narratives with Slide Decks and Infographics.
единицы.заметка: Начало фразы: «Nano Banana Pro is available to all» + ссылка «NotebookLM».

единицы.утверждение_en: NotebookLM Slide Decks can instantly convert trusted documents or even just high-level notes into fully styled decks suitable for both reading and presenting.
единицы.цитата: Slide Decks allow you to instantly convert trusted documents or even just high-level notes into fully styled decks, suitable for both reading and presenting.

единицы.утверждение_en: To visualize complex topics, you can run a Deep Research query in NotebookLM and then create a Slide Deck from it, instead of reading dense reports.

единицы.заметка: Фраза разорвана ссылкой: «For example, you can run a» + «Deep Research» + «query, create a Slide Deck and visualize complex topics without wading through dense reports.» (строки 266-268).

единицы.утверждение_en: If you have an existing deck draft, you can ask NotebookLM to create more visually appealing slides, even in a certain style of color palette.
единицы.цитата: And if you have an existing draft of a deck, just ask NotebookLM to create more visually appealing slides, even in a certain style of color palette.

единицы.утверждение_en: Workspace customers can use Nano Banana Pro in Google Slides and Google Vids.
единицы.цитата: can now use Nano Banana Pro in Google Slides and Google Vids.

единицы.утверждение_en: In Google Slides, open the Gemini sidebar and select "Help me visualize"; it uses the upgraded model (Nano Banana Pro) to help create infographics, images, charts and more.
единицы.цитата: In Slides, when you open up the Gemini sidebar and select the “Help me visualize” option, it will use the upgraded model to help create infographics, images, charts and more.

единицы.утверждение_en: Google Slides' "Beautify this slide" feature uses Nano Banana Pro, takes in the context of a slide you created and builds on its design; select "insert as new slide" to add the result to the presentation.
единицы.цитата: There’s also a new “Beautify this slide” feature that uses Nano Banana Pro and takes in the context of a slide you created and build on the design. If you like what Nano Banana Pro came up with, select “insert as new slide” to add it to your presentation.
единицы.заметка: Механизм: исходный слайд работает как контекст/референс дизайна.

единицы.утверждение_en: In Google Vids, Workspace customers who choose the "Image" option with the banana icon use Nano Banana Pro, and generating a video from scratch makes all visuals with the latest model.
единицы.цитата: Now when you choose the “Image” option with the banana icon from the sidebar, if you’re a Workspace customer, you’ll be using Nana Banana Pro — and if you generate a video from scratch, all the visuals will be made using the latest model.
единицы.заметка: В оригинале опечатка «Nana Banana Pro» — цитата дословная.

единицы.утверждение_en: Using Nano Banana Pro in Flow (Google's AI filmmaking tool) gives higher precision and control over frames and scenes, as well as state-of-the-art text rendering.
единицы.цитата: You can expect higher precision and control over frames and scenes, as well as state-of-the-art text rendering.

единицы.утверждение_en: In Flow, Nano Banana Pro is particularly helpful for tweaks such as adjusting camera angles, changing focus to create depth, or applying sophisticated color grading to set the mood.
единицы.цитата: This is particularly helpful for creatives, who might want to make tweaks like adjusting camera angles, changing focus to create depth or applying sophisticated color grading to set the perfect mood.
единицы.заметка: Три типа правки кадра: ракурс камеры, фокус/глубина (depth), цветокоррекция под настроение. Сказано как примеры того, что «might want» — не инструкция.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro is available in Flow for all paid plans.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro is available in Flow for all paid plans.
единицы.заметка: Из формулировки следует, что на бесплатном плане Flow — нет (прямо не сказано).

единицы.цитата: is an experiment from Google Labs to help you explore, expand and refine ideas. With Mixboard’s canvas, you can visualize different ideas using images or text for all kinds of projects

единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro is available in Mixboard’s newest presentations capability, which transforms your boards into beautifully designed presentations.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: In the Gemini app, Nano Banana Pro is reached via the "Thinking" model and silently hands over to the original Nano Banana once free-tier limits are hit, so a free user's later images may come from a different model than the first ones.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Слово «silently» — моё: страница не говорит, уведомляет ли приложение о переключении (см. не_сказано).

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro access is gated differently on each surface: global in the Gemini app and NotebookLM, select countries and English only in AI Mode, Workspace customers in Slides/Vids, paid plans only in Flow.

Across surfaces the page repeatedly frames Nano Banana Pro's advantage as precision and control (understanding intent via Gemini 3 Pro, precise image generation in Vids, control over frames/scenes and text rendering in Flow).

The entry point to Nano Banana Pro is an explicit, differently named option on each consumer surface ("Thinking" model in Gemini app, "Thinking with 3 Pro" + "Create Images Pro" in AI Mode, "Help me visualize"/"Beautify this slide" in Slides, banana-icon "Image" in Vids).
